purpose: Track intended cross-repository interfaces, their required trust boundaries, verification evidence, and blocking gaps. Registry status is authoritative only as a planning record; it does not itself prove runtime connectivity.
promotion_rule: An interface may become verified only with exact producer and consumer revisions, an executed integration test, a correlated request_id, a validated receipt/artifact digest, and inspectable test logs. Documentation or endpoint reachability alone is insufficient.

interfaces.purpose: Convert authenticated user intent into a typed constrained plan.
gaps: Default-branch workspace routes require authentication review; draft PR #7 is not merged.
Planner must reject invalid or unsupported constraint values, not merely echo them.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Unauthenticated intent submission is rejected; invalid constraints fail closed; valid plan binds caller, request, policy and immutable plan version.

interfaces.purpose: Authorize each planned action using scoped capabilities.
gaps: Capability verification must compare method as well as type and resource.
Cross-repository canonicalization needs shared test vectors for Unicode, escaping and numbers.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Read-only capability cannot authorize delete/execute; expired, revoked, wrong-resource and wrong-method capabilities fail.

interfaces.purpose: Pass a scoped, short-lived authorization to an isolated executor.
gaps: CycleKernal terminal uses shell execution without demonstrated strong sandboxing.
Swarm event endpoint needs authenticated worker identity and strict role/step transition checks.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Unauthenticated request and forged worker event cannot execute or mark a job complete; forbidden command and host access tests fail safely.

interfaces.purpose: Produce a trustworthy receipt for actual execution and output artifacts.
gaps: Simulation and real execution must be separate explicit modes.
A status/event message alone is not proof of work; receipt must bind output bytes and worker identity.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Simulation, missing receipt, altered artifact, wrong revision, forged event and expired receipt all fail acceptance.

interfaces.purpose: Persist verifier decisions with idempotent audit history.
gaps: New gate and ledger are draft PRs #34 and #35; stacked changes are not merged.
Ledger needs a production shared transactional store and independently anchored chain head for multi-host/privileged-tamper threat model.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Same request/evidence retry returns same receipt; conflicting retry is rejected; tampering breaks chain verification.

interfaces.purpose: Allow promotion only when evidence, policy and artifact identity all satisfy release criteria.
gaps: The evidence gate intentionally never authorizes production.
No universal promotion adapter is wired into all consumers.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Missing, stale, simulated, unsigned, replayed or mismatched evidence blocks promotion; accepted evidence alone does not bypass authorization.

interfaces.purpose: Publish versioned numerical diagnostics with method, assumptions and uncertainty.
gaps: Numerical estimate must not be labeled rigorous certification without a validated bound.
Model output is diagnostic evidence, not execution or production authorization.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Uncertified estimates are labelled estimates; malformed inputs and unmet convergence criteria cannot yield a certified PASS.

interfaces.purpose: Provide suggestions and source-attributed knowledge to planning without granting authority.
gaps: TrainLLM token issuance and route-level authentication require remediation.
Knowledge classifications must remain distinct from cryptographic verification.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Unverified model claims cannot mint capability or directly trigger production actions; source/version uncertainty is preserved.

interfaces.purpose: Bind immutable image/build output to source, builder, SBOM, provenance and signature.
gaps: Current publishing script permits unsigned output when COSIGN_KEY is absent.
Builder backends need equivalent required provenance or must be blocked for production.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Unsigned, untrusted, source-mismatched or provenance-incomplete artifacts cannot be admitted.

interfaces.purpose: Fetch bounded public metadata without reaching private infrastructure.
gaps: Hostname shape checks alone do not establish publicly routable destination; DNS rebinding and private/link-local destinations need protection.
interfaces.acceptance_test: Loopback, private, link-local, metadata IP, DNS rebinding and redirect-to-private targets are blocked.
